G800.b:
** ⟪ἀ-σύμφωνος⟫, -ον,
[in LXX: Wi 18:10, Da, LXX, Bel 15*;] ⟪dissonant⟫, ⟪discordant⟫; metaph., ⟪at variance⟫: πρὸς ἀλλήλους, ⟦Acts 28:25|Ac 28:25⟧.†

G801.b:
⟪ἀ-σύνετος⟫, -ον
[in LXX: ⟦Deuteronomy 32:21|De 32:21⟧ (⁨נָבָל⁩), ⟦Job 13:2|Jb 13:2⟧ (⁨נפל⁩), ⟦Psalms 92:6|Ps 91 (92):6⟧ (⁨כְּסִיל⁩), ⟦Psalms 76:5|Ps 75 (76):5⟧, Wi2, Si6*;] ⟪without understanding⟫ or ⟪discernment⟫: ⟦Matthew 15:16|Mt 15:16⟧, ⟦Mark 7:18|Mk 7:18⟧ (Swete, in l.), ⟦Romans 1:21|Ro 1:21⟧, ⟦Romans 1:31|31⟧ ⟦Romans 10:19|10:19⟧ (for an ex. of its use in the moral sense, v. MM, s.v.).†
a: Commentaries on the Gospel according to St. Mark (Third Edition, 1909) and the Apocalypse of St. John, by H. B. Swete. Macmillan, 1906

G802.b:
⟪ἀ-σύν-θετος⟫, -ον
(< συντίθεμαι; v. M, Pr., 222; MM, s.v.), [in LXX: ⟦Jeremiah 3:7|Je 3:7⟧, ⟦Jeremiah 3:8|8⟧, ⟦Jeremiah 3:10|10⟧, ⟦Jeremiah 3:11|11⟧ (⁨בּגד⁩)*;] ⟪false to engagements⟫, ⟪not keeping covenant⟫, ⟪faithless⟫ (MM, s.v.): ⟦Romans 1:31|Ro 1:31⟧.†
a: A Grammar of N.T. Greek. Vol. I, Prolegomena, by J. H. Moulton. Third Edition. Scribners, 1908

G803.b:
⟪ἀσφάλεια⟫, -ας, ἡ
(< ἀσφαλής), [in LXX for ⁨בֶּטַח⁩, etc.;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪firmness⟫.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪certainty⟫: ⟦Luke 1:4|Lk 1:4⟧.
⟪3.⟫ ⟪security⟫: ⟦Acts 5:23|Ac 5:23⟧, ⟦1 Thessalonians 5:3|I Th 5:3⟧. (In π. it is used as a law-term, proof, security; v. MM, s.v.; M, ⟦1 Thessalonians 5:3|I Th 5:3⟧.)†

G804.b:
⟪ἀσφαλής⟫, -ές
(< ἀ- neg., σφάλλω, to trip up), [in LXX for ⁨אשׁר⁩ pu., etc.;] ⟪certain⟫, ⟪secure⟫, ⟪safe⟫: ⟦Acts 21:34|Ac 21:34⟧ ⟦Acts 22:30|22:30⟧ ⟦Acts 25:26|25:26⟧, ⟦Philippians 3:1|Phl 3:1⟧, ⟦Hebrews 6:19|He 6:19⟧ (MM, s.v.).†

G805.b:
† ⟪ἀσφαλίζω⟫
(< ἀσφαλής), [in LXX: ⟦Nehemiah 3:15|Ne 3:15⟧ (⁨חזק⁩ hi.), ⟦Isaiah 41:10|Is 41:10⟧ (⁨תּמךְ⁩), Wi 4:17 10:12 13:15*;] ⟪to make firm⟫, ⟪secure⟫: mid., ⟦Matthew 27:65|Mt 27:65⟧, ⟦Matthew 27:66|66⟧, ⟦Acts 16:24|Ac 16:24⟧; pass., ⟦Matthew 27:64|Mt 27:64⟧ (MM, s.v.).†

G806.b:
⟪ἀσφαλῶς⟫, adv.,
[in LXX: ⟦Genesis 34:25|Ge 34:25⟧ (⁨בֶּטַח⁩), To 6:4, Wi 18:6, Ba 5:7, I Mac 6:40, III Mac 7:6*;]
⟪(a)⟫ ⟪safely⟫: ⟦Mark 14:44|Mk 14:44⟧, ⟦Acts 16:23|Ac 16:23⟧;
⟪(b)⟫ ⟪assuredly⟫: ⟦Acts 2:36|Ac 2:36⟧.†

G807.b:
⟪ἀσχημονέω⟫, -ῶ
(< ἀσχήμαων), [in LXX: ⟦Ezekiel 16:7|Ez 16:7⟧, ⟦Ezekiel 16:22|22⟧, ⟦Ezekiel 16:39|39⟧ ⟦Ezekiel 23:29|23:29⟧ (⁨עֶרְיָה⁩); ⟦Deuteronomy 25:3|De 25:3⟧ (⁨קלה⁩ ni.)*;] ⟪to act unbecomingly⟫, ⟪behave dishonourably⟫: ⟦1 Corinthians 13:5|I Co 13:5⟧; seq. ἐπί, ⟦1 Corinthians 7:36|I Co 7:36⟧ (MM, s.v.).†

G808.b:
⟪ἀσχημοσύνη⟫, -ης, ἡ
(< ἀσχήμων), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨עֶרְוָה⁩;] ⟪unseemliness⟫: ⟦Romans 1:27|Ro 1:27⟧ (MM, s.v.); euphemism for ἡ αἰσχύνη, as freq. in LXX, ⟪shame⟫, ⟪nakedness⟫: ⟦Revelation 16:15|Re 16:15⟧.†

G809.b:
⟪ἀσχήμων⟫, -ον
(< ἀ- neg., σχῆμα), [in LXX: ⟦Genesis 34:7|Ge 34:7⟧ (⁨נְבָלָה⁩), ⟦Deuteronomy 24:1|De 24:1⟧ (⁨עֶרְוָה⁩), Wi 2:20, Da TH Sus 63, II Mac 9:2*;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪shapeless⟫.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪uncomely⟫, ⟪unseemly⟫: ⟦1 Corinthians 12:23|I Co 12:23⟧.†

G810.b:
⟪ἀσωτία⟫, -ας, ἡ
(< ἀ- neg., σώζω), [in LXX: ⟦Proverbs 28:7|Pr 28:7⟧ (⁨זלל⁩), II Mac 6:4*;] ⟪prodigality⟫, ⟪wastefulness⟫, ⟪profligacy⟫: ⟦Ephesians 5:18|Eph 5:18⟧, ⟦Titus 1:6|Tit 1:6⟧, ⟦1 Peter 4:4|I Pe 4:4⟧ (MM, s.v.).†
SYN.: ἀσέλγεια, q.v.

G811.b:
* ⟪ἀσώτως⟫, adv.
(< ἄσωτος, prodigal, wasteful), [in LXX for ⁨סרר⁩, ⟦Proverbs 7:11|Pr 7:11⟧*;] ⟪wastefully⟫: ⟦Luke 15:13|Lk 15:13⟧ (EV, in riotous living; but not necessarily dissolute; cf. MM, ut supr.; Milligan, NTD, 79).†
a: The New Testament Documents, by G. Milligan. Macmillan, 1913

G812.b:
* ⟪ἀτακτέω⟫, -ῶ
(< ἄτακτος), primarily, of soldiers marching, ⟪to be out of order⟫, ⟪to quit the ranks⟫; hence, metaph., ⟪to be remiss⟫, ⟪fail in the performance of duty⟫ (in π., of truancy on the part of an apprentice): ⟦2 Thessalonians 3:7|II Th 3:7⟧ (on ἀ. and its cognates, v. M, Th., 152 ff.; MM, s.vv.).†
a: St. Paul's Epistles to the Thessalonians, by G. Milligan. Macmillan, 1908

G813.b:
** ⟪ἄ-τακτος⟫, -ον
(< τάσσω), [in LXX: III Mac 1:19*;] ⟪out of order⟫, ⟪out of place⟫ (Lat. inordinatus), freq. of soldiers not keeping the ranks, or an army in disarray (cf. III Mac 1:19); hence, metaph., ⟪irregular⟫, ⟪disorderly⟫ (v. previous word): ⟦1 Thessalonians 5:14|I Th 5:14⟧.†

G814.b:
** ⟪ἀ-τάκτως⟫, adv.,
[in Sm.: ⟦2 Kings 9:20|IV Ki 9:20⟧*;] ⟪disorderly⟫, ⟪irregularly⟫: ⟦2 Thessalonians 3:6|II Th 3:6⟧, ⟦2 Thessalonians 3:11|11⟧.†

G816.b:
** ⟪ἀτενίζω⟫
(< ἀτενής, strained, intent; < τείνω), [in LXX: I Es 6:28, III Mac 2:26*;] ⟪to look fixedly⟫, ⟪gaze⟫ (MM, s.v.): c. dat. pers., ⟪gaze upon⟫: ⟦Luke 4:20|Lk 4:20⟧ ⟦Luke 22:56|22:56⟧, ⟦Acts 3:12|Ac 3:12⟧ ⟦Acts 10:4|10:4⟧ ⟦Acts 14:9|14:9⟧ ⟦Acts 23:1|23:1⟧; seq. εἰς, c. acc. pers., ⟦Acts 3:4|Ac 3:4⟧ ⟦Acts 6:15|6:15⟧ ⟦Acts 13:9|13:9⟧; metaph., ⟦Acts 1:10|Ac 1:10⟧ ⟦Acts 7:55|7:55⟧ ⟦Acts 11:6|11:6⟧, ⟦2 Corinthians 3:7|II Co 3:7⟧, ⟦2 Corinthians 3:13|13⟧.†

G817.b:
** ⟪ἄτερ⟫, prep.,
[in LXX: II Mac 12:15*;] in cl. most freq. in poets; ⟪without⟫, ⟪apart from⟫: c. gen., ⟦Luke 22:6|Lk 22:6⟧, ⟦Luke 22:35|35⟧ (for exx. from π., v. MM, s.v.).†

G818.b:
⟪ἀτιμάζω⟫
(< ἄτιμος), [in LXX for ⁨בּוּז⁩, ⁨קלה⁩, etc.;] ⟪to dishonour⟫, ⟪insult⟫: ⟦Mark 12:4|Mk 12:4⟧, TTr., mg., WH, ⟦Luke 20:11|Lk 20:11⟧, ⟦John 8:49|Jo 8:49⟧, ⟦Romans 2:23|Ro 2:23⟧, ⟦James 2:6|Ja 2:6⟧; pass.: ⟦Acts 5:41|Ac 5:41⟧, ⟦Romans 1:24|Ro 1:24⟧ (cf ἀτιμάω).†
a: The N.T. in the original Greek, by B. F. Westcott and F. J. A. Hort. Vol. II, Introduction and Appendix. Macmillan, 1881

G819.b:
⟪ἀτιμία⟫, -ας, ἡ
(ἄτιμος), [in LXX for ⁨כְּלִמָּה⁩, ⁨קָלוֹן⁩, etc.;] ⟪dishonour⟫, ⟪disgrace⟫: ⟦1 Corinthians 11:14|I Co 11:14⟧, ⟦2 Corinthians 6:8|II Co 6:8⟧; εἰς ἀ., ⟦Romans 9:21|Ro 9:21⟧, ⟦2 Timothy 2:20|II Ti 2:20⟧; ἐν ἀ., ⟦1 Corinthians 15:43|I Co 15:43⟧; κατ᾽ ἀ., ⟦2 Corinthians 11:21|II Co 11:21⟧; πάθη ἀτιμίας, ⟪base passions⟫, ⟦Romans 1:26|Ro 1:26⟧.†

G820.b:
⟪ἄτιμος⟫, -ον
(< τιμή), [in LXX: ⟦Isaiah 3:5|Is 3:5⟧ (⁨קלה⁩ ni.), ⟦Isaiah 53:3|Is 53:3⟧ (⁨בּזה⁩), ⟦Job 30:4|Jb 30:4⟧, ⟦Job 30:8|8⟧ (⁨בְּלִי־שֵׁם⁩), Wi5, Si1*;] ⟪without honour⟫, ⟪dishonoured⟫, ⟪despised⟫: ⟦Matthew 13:57|Mt 13:57⟧, ⟦Mark 6:4|Mk 6:4⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 4:10|I Co 4:10⟧; comp., ⟦1 Corinthians 12:23|I Co 12:23⟧.†

G821.b:
⟪ἀτιμόω⟫, -ῶ
(< ἄτιμος), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨בּזה⁩;] = ἀτιμάζω, ⟪to dishonour⟫, ⟪treat with indignity⟫: ⟦Mark 12:4|Mk 12:4⟧, Rec.†

G822.b:
⟪ἀτμίς⟫, -ίδος, ἡ,
[in LXX for ⁨עָנָן⁩, ⁨תִּימָרָה⁩, etc.;] ⟪vapour⟫: ⟦James 4:14|Ja 4:14⟧; ἀ. καπνοῦ, ⟦Acts 2:19|Ac 2:19⟧(LXX).†

G823.b:
** ⟪ἄ-τομος⟫, -ον
(< τέμνω), [in Sm.: ⟦Isaiah 54:8|Is 54:8⟧ (MM, s.v.)*;] ⟪indivisible⟫; of time, ἄτομον, ⟪a moment⟫: ἐν ἄ., ⟦1 Corinthians 15:52|I Co 15:52⟧.†

G824.b:
⟪ἄ-τοπος⟫, -ον
(< τόπος), [in LXX: ⟦Job 4:8|Jb 4:8⟧ ⟦Job 11:11|11:11⟧, ⟦Proverbs 30:20|Pr 30:20⟧ (⟦Proverbs 24:55|24:55⟧), al., for ⁨אָוֶן⁩, etc.;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪out of place⟫, ⟪not befitting⟫.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪marvellous⟫, ⟪strange⟫ (of symptoms, Hipp.): ⟦Acts 28:6|Ac 28:6⟧; hence, in late Greek, with ethical sense,
⟪3.⟫ ⟪improper⟫, ⟪unrighteous⟫ (so in LXX, and for exx. from π., v. M, ⟦2 Thessalonians 3:2|II Th., 3:2⟧; MM, s.v.): ⟦Luke 23:41|Lk 23:41⟧, ⟦Acts 25:5|Ac 25:5⟧, ⟦2 Thessalonians 3:2|II Th 3:2⟧.†

G826.b:
⟪αὐγάζω⟫
(< αὐγή), [in LXX: ⟦Leviticus 13:24|Le 13:24-26⟧, ⟦Leviticus 13:28|28⟧, ⟦Leviticus 13:38|38⟧ ⟦Leviticus 14:56|14:56⟧ (⁨בַּהֶרֶת⁩) ⟦Leviticus 13:39|13:39⟧ (⁨כֵּהֶה⁩)*;]
⟪1.⟫ Trans. (cl.), ⟪to irradiate⟫.
⟪2.⟫ Intrans.
	⟪(a)⟫ (poët.), ⟪to see clearly⟫ (so perh. ⟦2 Corinthians 4:4|II Co 4:4⟧; MM, s.v.);
	⟪(b)⟫ as in LXX, ⟪to shine forth⟫: ⟦2 Corinthians 4:4|II Co 4:4⟧ (cf. δι-, κατ-αυγάζω).†

G827.b:
⟪αὐγή⟫, -ῆς, ἡ,
[in LXX: ⟦Isaiah 59:9|Is 59:9⟧ (⁨נְגֹהָה⁩), II Mac 12:9*;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪brightness⟫
⟪2.⟫ Later (as in MGr.; MM, s.v.), ⟪daylight⟫, ⟪dawn⟫: ⟦Acts 20:11|Ac 20:11⟧ (Cremer, 118).†
SYN.: φέγγος (v. Thayer, s. φ.; DB, iii, 44a; Tr., Syn., § xlvi).
a: Biblico-Theological Lexicon of N.T. Greek, by H. Cremer. Third English Edition, with Supplement. T. & T. Clark, 1886
Dictionary of the Bible, edited by J. Hastings. 5 vols. (i-iv, ext. = extra vol.). Scribners, 1898-1904
Synonyms of the N. T. , by R. C. Trench. Ninth Edition. Macmillan, 1880

G828.b: ⟪Αὔγουστος⟫, -ου, ὁ (Lat.), ⟪Augustus⟫, the Roman Emperor: ⟦Luke 2:1|Lk 2:1⟧ (cf. Σεβαστός; and v. MM, s.v.).†

G829.b:
⟪αὐθάδης⟫, -ες
(< αὐτός, ἥδομαι), [in LXX: ⟦Genesis 49:3|Ge 49:3⟧, ⟦Genesis 49:7|7⟧ (⁨עַז⁩), ⟦Proverbs 21:24|Pr 21:24⟧ (⁨יָהִיר⁩)*;] ⟪self-pleasing⟫, ⟪arrogant⟫: ⟦Titus 1:7|Tit 1:7⟧, ⟦2 Peter 2:10|II Pe 2:10⟧ (Cremer, 654).†
SYN.: φίλαυτος (v. Tr., Syn., § xciii).

Synonyms of the N. T. , by R. C. Trench. Ninth Edition. Macmillan, 1880

G830.b:
** ⟪αὐθαίρετος⟫, -ον
(< αὐτός, αἱρέομαι), [in Sm.: ⟦Exodus 35:5|Ex 35:5⟧, ⟦Exodus 35:22|22⟧*;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪self-chosen⟫.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪of one's own accord⟫: ⟦2 Corinthians 8:3|II Co 8:3⟧, ⟦2 Corinthians 8:17|17⟧.†

G831.b:
*† ⟪αὐθεντέω⟫, -ῶ
(< αὐθέντης, i.e. αὐτο- ἕντης, one who acts on his own authority, in π., an autocrat; cf. Wi 12:6; cf. -ία, III Mac 2:29; -ικος is freq. in vernacular, MM, s.v.), ⟪to govern⟫, ⟪exercise authority over⟫: ⟦1 Timothy 2:12|I Ti 2:12⟧.†

G832.b:
** ⟪αὐλέω⟫, -ῶ
(< αὐλός), [in Al.: ⟦1 Kings 1:40|III Ki 1:40⟧*;] ⟪to play on a flute⟫, ⟪to pipe⟫: mid., ⟦Matthew 11:17|Mt 11:17⟧, ⟦Luke 7:32|Lk 7:32⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 14:7|I Co 14:7⟧.†

G833.b:
⟪αὐλή⟫, -ῆς, ἡ,
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨חָצֵר⁩;]
⟪1.⟫ in Hom., ⟪an open courtyard⟫ before a house, hence, ⟪an enclosure in the open⟫, ⟪a sheepfold⟫: ⟦John 10:1|Jo 10:1⟧, ⟦John 10:16|16⟧.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪the court⟫, ⟪courtyard⟫, round which a house is built: ⟦Matthew 26:3|Mt 26:3⟧, ⟦Matthew 26:58|58⟧, ⟦Matthew 26:69|69⟧, ⟦Mark 14:54|Mk 14:54⟧, ⟦Mark 14:66|66⟧ ⟦Mark 15:16|15:16⟧, ⟦Luke 11:21|Lk 11:21⟧ ⟦Luke 22:55|22:55⟧, ⟦John 18:15|Jo 18:15⟧; τ. ναοῦ, ⟦Revelation 11:2|Re 11:2⟧.
⟪3⟫ ⟪a dwelling⟫, ⟪a palace⟫ (so, acc. to Grimm-Th., s.v.): ⟦Matthew 26:3|Mt 26:3⟧, ⟦Matthew 26:58|58⟧, ⟦Mark 14:54|Mk 14:54⟧ ⟦Mark 15:16|15:16⟧, ⟦Luke 11:21|Lk 11:21⟧, ⟦John 18:15|Jo 18:15⟧ (but v. MM, s.v.; cf. also DB, ii, 25, 287).†
a: Dictionary of the Bible, edited by J. Hastings. 5 vols. (i-iv, ext. = extra vol.). Scribners, 1898-1904

G835.b:
⟪αὐλίζομαι⟫
(< αὐλή), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨לון⁩, ⁨לון⁩;]
⟪1.⟫ prop., ⟪to lodge in a courtyard⟫.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪to lodge in the open⟫.
⟪3.⟫ ⟪to pass the night⟫, ⟪lodge⟫ (LXX; MM, s.v.): ⟦Matthew 21:17|Mt 21:17⟧, ⟦Luke 21:37|Lk 21:37⟧.†

G836.b:
⟪αὐλός⟫, -οῦ, ὁ
(< ἄω, to blow), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨חָלִיל⁩;] ⟪a pipe⟫: ⟦1 Corinthians 14:7|I Co 14:7⟧.†

G837.b:
⟪αὐξάνω⟫
(and the earlier form αὔξω, ⟦Ephesians 2:21|Eph 2:21⟧, ⟦Colossians 2:19|Col 2:19⟧; MM, s.v.), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨פּרה⁩;]
⟪1.⟫ trans., ⟪to make to grow⟫: ⟦1 Corinthians 3:6|I Co 3:6⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 3:7|7⟧, ⟦2 Corinthians 9:10|II Co 9:10⟧. Pass., ⟪to grow⟫, ⟪increase⟫, ⟪become greater⟫: ⟦Matthew 13:32|Mt 13:32⟧, ⟦Mark 4:8|Mk 4:8⟧, ⟦2 Corinthians 10:15|II Co 10:15⟧, ⟦Colossians 1:6|Col 1:6⟧; τῇ ἐπιγνώσει τ. θεοῦ, ⟦Colossians 1:10|Col 1:10⟧; εἰς σωτηρίαν, ⟦1 Peter 2:2|I Pe 2:2⟧.
⟪2.⟫ In later Gk. (but nowhere in LXX), intrans., ⟪to grow⟫, ⟪increase⟫: of plants, ⟦Matthew 6:28|Mt 6:28⟧, ⟦Luke 12:27|Lk 12:27⟧ ⟦Luke 13:19|13:19⟧; of infants, ⟦Luke 1:80|Lk 1:80⟧ ⟦Luke 2:40|2:40⟧; of a multitude, ⟦Acts 7:17|Ac 7:17⟧; of the increase of the Gospel: ὁ λόγος ηὔξανε, ⟦Acts 6:7|Ac 6:7⟧ ⟦Acts 12:24|12:24⟧ ⟦Acts 19:20|19:20⟧; of Christ as a leader, ⟦John 3:30|Jo 3:30⟧; of Christian character: εἰς Χριοτόν, ⟦Ephesians 4:15|Eph 4:15⟧; εἰς ναόν, ⟦Ephesians 2:21|Eph 2:21⟧; ἐν χάριτι, ⟦2 Peter 3:18|II Pe 3:18⟧; τὴν αὔξησιν τ. θεσῦ, ⟦Colossians 2:19|Col 2:19⟧ (cf. συν, ὑπερ-αυξάνω).†

G839.b:
⟪αὔριον⟫ adv.,
[in LXX for ⁨מָחָר⁩;] ⟪to-morrow⟫: ⟦Matthew 6:30|Mt 6:30⟧, ⟦Luke 12:28|Lk 12:28⟧, ⟦Acts 23:20|Ac 23:20⟧ ⟦Acts 25:22|25:22⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 15:32|I Co 15:32⟧, ⟦Luke 13:32|Lk 13:32⟧, ⟦Luke 13:33|33⟧, ⟦James 4:13|Ja 4:13⟧; ἡ αὔ. (sc. ἡμέρα, MM, s.v.), ⟦Matthew 6:34|Mt 6:34⟧, ⟦Acts 4:3|Ac 4:3⟧; ἐπὶ τὴν αὔ., ⟦Luke 10:35|Lk 10:35⟧, ⟦Acts 4:5|Ac 4:5⟧; τὸ (WH om.) τῆς αὔ. ⟦James 4:14|Ja 4:14⟧.†
a: The N.T. in the original Greek, by B. F. Westcott and F. J. A. Hort. Vol. II, Introduction and Appendix. Macmillan, 1881

G840.b:
** ⟪αὐστηρός⟫, -ά, -όν
(< αὔω, to dry up), [in LXX: II Mac 14:30*;] prop., ⟪stringent⟫, ⟪harsh⟫ to the taste. Metaph., in Inscr., of a rough country; of disposition and manners, ⟪strict⟫, ⟪severe⟫ (as in π., of an inspector; MM, s v): ⟦Luke 19:21|Lk 19:21⟧, ⟦Luke 19:22|22⟧.†

G896.b: ⟪Βάαλ⟫ (Rec. βαάλ), ὁ, ἡ, indecl. (Heb. ⁨בַּעַל⁩, ⟪lord⟫), ⟪Baal⟫: ⟦Romans 11:4|Ro 11:4⟧(LXX). The fem. art. here agrees with the usage of LXX, where, following a similar Hebrew practice (⁨בֹּשֶׁת⁩ for ⁨בַּעַל⁩), αἰσχύνη appears to have been substituted in reading for the written Βάαλ (cf. ⟦1 Kings 18:19|III Ki 18:19⟧), and to account for the freq. use of the fem. art. bef. Β. The usage, however, is not general, and in the passage cited in Ro (⟦1 Kings 19:18|III Ki 19:18⟧), LXX reads τῷ Β.†
